# from published physiology, never from this project's panel output. Changing a
# row after panel results are known invalidates the stratum as a negative
# control, so amendments must be a separate commit with a stated reason.

# run an acidic, ionic-strength-adapted proteome instead of accumulating
# organic osmolytes. They therefore sit at MAXIMUM NaCl tolerance with the
# Left unlabelled they are high-phenotype/low-panel points that damage any
# monotone model; dropped silently they are cherry-picking. Declared up front
# they become a negative control -- see README.md for the directional
# prediction, which is family-specific, NOT "low breadth".
# CAUTION, name prefixes do not indicate strategy:
#   - Halomonas is salt-OUT. It is the textbook ectoine producer. Likewise
